name: NovManager MCP Server Specification
description: Standard Model Context Protocol (MCP) server definitions for NovManager. Allows external coding and creative agents (e.g. Claude Desktop, Cursor, OpenHands) to read structured novel context and mutate manuscript drafts, character states, and outlines.

resources.name: Novel Metadata & Style Guide
resources.description: Returns novel title, genre, target word count, narrative POV, and comprehensive style constraints.

resources.name: World-Building & Lore Index
resources.description: Returns all registered world settings, categorized into geography, factions, power systems, items, and fundamental laws.

resources.name: Character Profiles Directory
resources.description: Lists all characters with static profiles (appearance, psychology, voice/tone) and current dynamic states.

resources.name: Single Character Full Dossier
resources.description: Detailed dossier of a specific character including timeline state evolution and relational affinity graph.

resources.name: Full Hierarchy Outline Tree
resources.description: Complete hierarchical outline tree covering Volumes, Chapters, and Scene Breakdowns.

resources.name: Assembled Context Bundle for Chapter
resources.description: Pre-assembled contextual bundle for writing or reviewing a specific chapter (goal, cast, prior recap, related foreshadowing).

resources.name: Active Foreshadowing & Clues
resources.description: List of all clues planted in previous chapters that are currently unresolved and available for development.

tools.name: query_lore
tools.description: Performs semantic and hybrid search over the novel's world-building rules, magic/combat systems, and historical lore.

query.description: Natural language query about a rule, item, location, or faction

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: query_plot_memory
tools.description: Retrieves semantic slices and summaries of past chapters to verify continuity and prevent plot holes.

query.description: Question or topic regarding past events

before_chapter_index.description: Only search events strictly preceding this chapter index

tools.name: save_scene_draft
tools.description: Saves a generated scene draft into the chapter repository. Creates an auditable version snapshot.

scene_index.description: 1-based index of the scene within the chapter

agent_notes.description: Agent commentary on plot advancements and subtle clues planted

tools.name: update_character_state
tools.description: Mutates a character's dynamic attributes following narrative events (e.g. injury, rank advancement, relocation).

chapter_id.description: UUID of the current chapter where the change occurred

combat_power.description: Updated combat tier or cultivation stage

state_summary.description: Brief explanation of how and why the state changed

tools.name: record_foreshadowing
tools.description: Registers a new foreshadowing clue planted in the current chapter into the tracking radar.

clue_description.description: Detailed text description of the planted seed

planted_chapter_id.description: UUID of the chapter where the clue was written

planned_resolve_chapter_id.description: UUID of the projected chapter to resolve this clue

tools.name: check_setting_consistency
tools.description: Audits a piece of prose draft against world lore, character profiles, and narrative constraints for logic violations.

draft_text.description: The prose content to be inspected

involved_character_ids.description: IDs of characters featured in this draft
